item.title: Meet Our Founder: Rosetta Graydon - Edmonton Humane Society
item.description: Read our founder’s inspiring story and learn about how one woman’s vision changed the lives of countless animals. Let’s continue to honour and celebrate people like Rosetta, who make a lasting difference every day.

item.title: Thriving Together: Our 2025-2029 Strategic Plan - Edmonton Humane Society
item.description: Every day, we see the incredible ways that animals bring joy, companionship and connection to people’s lives. We're proud to introduce our 2025-2029 Strategic Plan that will shape the next chapter of EHS.

item.title: 5 Things You Might Not Know About EHS - Edmonton Humane Society
item.description: When you think of EHS, animal adoptions probably come to mind. And while finding loving homes is a big part of our mission, there’s so much more happening behind the scenes to support both animals and the people who care for them.

item.description: Yesterday, City Council approved the updated Animal Care and Control bylaw — a key step in strengthening protections for animals and supporting responsible pet guardianship in Edmonton. This is the first major update to the bylaw in over 20 years, […]

item.title: What Matters Most for Animal Welfare? - Edmonton Humane Society
item.description: We asked our community what animal welfare issues matter most to you. People across Alberta shared their thoughts, and their input helps shape how we advocate and build programs that help pets and people thrive, together.

item.title: EHS Achieves Humane Canada Accreditation - Edmonton Humane Society
item.description: EHS has received national accreditation from Humane Canada. This recognition makes us the first shelter in Western Canada and one of only three in the country to achieve Humane Canada accreditation.

item.title: Our Response to Proposed Changes to Alberta’s Animal Protection Act - Edmonton Humane Society
item.description: Earlier this week, the Government of Alberta introduced proposed updates to the Animal Protection Act. We see this as an important and much-needed step toward strengthening how animal welfare is addressed in our province.

item.title: Holiday Hazards for Pets &amp; Top Gift Suggestions - Edmonton Humane Society
item.description: Every year we get the opportunity to celebrate many holidays with our pets, which includes lots of food, gifts, and the excitement of gathering with loved ones. To help you when preparing for holiday festivities with your pet, we’re sharing some of our top tips on how to keep pets safe!
